title: 我是小鹿
setting: Thursday, 10 pm. You matched on a dating app and swapped WeChats.

giveup.zh: 消息已发出，但被对方拒收了。

giveup.en: Xiao Lu blocked you. Dabai the goose will never know your name.

steps.narr: You've added Xiao Lu. You can start chatting now.
steps.zh: 你已添加了小鹿，现在可以开始聊天了。
看你资料上写着喜欢吃火锅？
steps.en: Your profile says you like hotpot?

say.en: Yes! Tell her you love spicy food.
say.gloss: Yeah, I absolutely love spicy food!

not.note: That says you can't take spice.

say.tip: 超爱 = absolutely love (超 = super). 吃辣 = eat spicy food. 无辣不欢 is the idiom: no spice, no joy.

ok.en: I can handle 'insanely hot', the top of the menu.

3.en: Yes! Tell her you love spicy food: the hotter the better.
answers: 对啊，我超爱吃辣，越辣越好！
是啊，我特别能吃辣，越辣越好。
嗯嗯，越辣越好，我超爱吃辣的！
3.gloss: Yeah, I love spicy food. The hotter the better!
3.tip: 越……越…… = the more …, the more …: 越辣越好 = the hotter the better.

steps.en: So what do you usually do at weekends?

say.en: Send a voice message: mostly you sleep in at home, haha.
say.gloss: Usually I just sleep in at home, haha.
say.tip: 睡懒觉 = sleep in (literally, sleep a lazy sleep). 一般 = usually. 宅 = stay in, be a homebody.

ok.en: Haha, what a coincidence, me too!

fail.en: You haven't fallen asleep, have you?

3.en: Send a voice message: nothing much, really. You just sleep in at home.
answers: 其实也没干嘛，就在家睡懒觉。
也没干啥，一般就宅在家里。
没干什么，在家睡懒觉，哈哈。
3.gloss: Nothing much, really. I just sleep in at home.
3.tip: 也没干嘛 = nothing much (playing it down). 就 = just.

steps.en: My mum nags me every day to find someone.

say.en: You saw that. Seize the moment: suggest hotpot together this weekend.
answers: 那周末一起去吃火锅吧？
要不这周末一起吃火锅？
周末一起去吃火锅怎么样？
say.gloss: Then shall we go for hotpot together this weekend?
say.tip: 一起去……吧？ = shall we go and … together? 要不 = how about. 约个火锅 = make a hotpot date.

alts.en: Tease her: say you saw the unsent message

then.en: So why haven't you asked me out yet?

3.en: You saw that. Seize the moment: ask if she's free this weekend, and suggest hotpot together.
answers: 你周末有空吗？一起吃火锅吧！
有空的话，周末一起吃火锅吧？
这周末有时间吗？咱们约个火锅？
周末要是有空，我们去吃火锅？
3.gloss: Are you free this weekend? Let's get hotpot together!
3.tip: 有空 yǒu kòng = free (to do something). Asking 你周末有空吗？ first makes it easy to say yes.

say.en: Suggest Saturday, 7 pm, outside the hotpot place.
answers: 周六晚上七点，火锅店门口见！
周六晚上七点，店门口见？
星期六晚上七点，在火锅店门口？
周六七点，地铁站出口见吧。
say.gloss: Saturday, 7 pm, see you outside the hotpot place!
say.tip: Time goes big to small: 周六, then 晚上, then 七点, then the place. 门口见 = see you at the door.

3.en: Suggest Saturday, 7 pm, outside the hotpot place, and check that works for her.
answers: 周六七点，火锅店门口见，行吗？
周六晚上七点，店门口见，你看行吗？
星期六晚上七点，火锅店门口，可以吗？
周六七点，在火锅店门口见，方便吗？
3.gloss: Saturday, 7 pm, outside the hotpot place. Does that work?
3.tip: ……，行吗？ = does that work (for you)? 你看行吗？ is softer still: it turns a plan into a suggestion.

steps.en: Oh, and can I bring Dabai?

steps.zh: 一只大白鹅，脖子上系着粉色蝴蝶结
steps.en: A big white goose with a pink bow round its neck.

steps.zh: 它很乖的，就是偶尔咬人
steps.en: It's very good. It only bites people now and then.

say.en: Of course it can come. (Ask whether it eats hotpot.)
answers: 当然可以，它咬我怎么办？
say.gloss: Of course! Does it eat hotpot?
say.tip: 当然可以 = of course. 带上它 = bring it along. 它 is 'it', for animals and things.

alts.en: Ask if a hotpot place will even let a goose in
alts.gloss: Will a hotpot place even let a goose in?

then.zh: 我问过了，老板说只要它不进锅就行
then.en: I asked. The owner says it's fine, as long as it doesn't end up in the pot.

1.en: Say of course it can come.

alts.gloss: Can you even take a goose in?

3.en: Of course it can come, as long as it doesn't bite you.
answers: 当然可以，只要它别咬我就行！
可以啊，只要它不咬人就行。
没问题！只要它乖乖的就行。
当然可以，就是别让它咬我哈！
3.gloss: Of course, as long as it doesn't bite me!
3.tip: 只要……就行 = as long as …, that's fine. 咬 yǎo = bite: 别咬我 = don't bite me.

steps.en: Saturday, 7 pm, outside the hotpot place: Xiao Lu, a pink bow, and a goose that hisses at the waiter.
steps.zh: 周六晚上，火锅店门口站着小鹿和一只鹅。
